name: weld closure kinds claude topology and tier routing into one router
asks: Three thirds of one mechanism exist unjoined: claude-topology.mts's formal tier structure (opus/fable F0, sonnet F1, haiku F2, peer formality surfaces not a capability order), the executive-office glossary's closure-kind taxonomy (process/procedure/derivation/inquiry, classifying which operations need inference at all and which need a fuel cap), and the seated requirement route-work-by-measured-complexity-across-inference-tiers. The weld: annotate every skill with its closure-kind, and the annotation becomes mechanically routable — process needs no model, procedure and derivation go to cheap or free endpoints, only genuine inquiry spends F0 attention. This is the RSI engine's fuel injection: it is what makes 'heavy reasoning once, recall-the-proof forever' an enforced property of dispatch rather than a habit. The met-when conditions of the routing requirement already ask for exactly these pieces; nothing yet connects them.
